sloka: प्राप्स्यामि तपसा काममिति कृत्वा ऽध्यवस्य च ।आगच्छदात्मसिद्ध्यर्थं गोकर्णस्याश्रमं शुभम् ।। ७.९.४७ ॥
transliteration: prāpsyāmi tapasā kāmamiti kṛtvā 'dhyavasya ca ।āgacchadātmasiddhyarthaṁ gokarṇasyāśramaṁ śubham ।। 7.9.47 ॥

translations.english: Having resolved that he would achieve his desires through penance, he then came to the auspicious hermitage of Gokarna for the accomplishment of his own purpose.
